- MMLU-Pro 4B: decoding V1 − KEEP +1.42 [+0.23, +2.63]; aggregation V5 − V1 +1.74 [+0.84, +2.61]; F2 ALL = completion +0.38 + content +6.25 − format loss 0.20 − content damage 6.54.
